rubric.notes: Full marks are awarded for a complete, error-free derivation of vo(t) using the required nodal analysis. Part marks are deducted for specific procedural errors, arithmetic mistakes, or missing units as defined in the rubric. A solution that fails to provide the final time-domain expression vo(t) cannot receive full marks.
rubric.answer_key: The student must define the supernode around the dependent source, write the KCL equations in the phasor domain using impedances ZL=jωL and ZC=1/(jωC), solve the resulting system for the phasor Vo, and convert the result to the time-domain form vo(t) = Vm cos(ωt + φ) V.
